design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (alignment_plan_service), frozen 2026-10-14 10:20:00 EDT. Revision 3 (render/KB-audit round): every factor now contributes on its own — the renewal-rate and cardholder reductions are percentages of plan_price, the grace period decides its own reinstatement charge (0.00 inside grace, 20.00 outside) instead of gating the renewal rate, the readjustment slip and cardholder reductions are percentages of the parts amount set by the warranty, and credits are separate amounts; the order of assembly lives only in the result binding. Figures: readjustment 16.16 (was 16.25), renewal 112.59 unchanged; renewal all-baseline 239.99.  [Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,5]. Assignment: root alignment_ext_term_renewal 6, prerequisite alignment_ext_readjustment_parts 5.

[Why this is a good test] The customer only wants to renew his expired Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan on his 2018 Ford F-150. The renewal rule waits on every readjustment of the renewal day under the expired plan carrying its guarantee basis, and the records show the store's readjustment of this morning still open (basis none). The agent must discover that, book the readjustment as a guarantee readjustment with a parts charge worked out under the parts warranty (prorated by miles, slip reduction, cardholder reduction, new-tire and road hazard credits), and only then price the renewal: grace period anchored on the last plan alignment in the final six months (not on the expiration date), a renewal-rate reduction by the number of included alignments, a reinstatement charge decided by the grace anchor, a same-day readjustment credit that exists only once step 11 has landed, a cardholder rate, a Plus-certificate credit and the renewal tire bundle.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: alignment_ext_open_visit_labor, alignment_ext_open_visit_parts, alignment_ext_cancellation_settlement, alignment_ext_household_enrollment and their four tools. Claimed by task 1: alignment_ext_readjustment_parts (price_alignment_readjustment_e00d4c5e) and alignment_ext_term_renewal (renew_alignment_plan_418ab11e, user). Different events (alignment_readjustment, alignment_purchase as a renewal), different customer world; no remaining policy or tool is unclaimed.

[Problem-tree card] root R alignment_ext_term_renewal (user tool). Edge R -> J, value_input, gate readjustment_day_credit, form state, sentence "A renewal is priced only after every readjustment under the expired plan dated the renewal day carries its guarantee basis." Four-point test: "only after"; record-visible state (alignment_events.service_basis of the day's readjustments); no tool/id/code; scope exactly the readjustments of the renewal day under the expired plan. Exactly one write of this difficulty sets a readjustment's basis: the readjustment booking. False at opening: alignment_events[RJ].service_basis = none. Skip J -> renewal 137.59 instead of 112.59. Direction: affirmative "only after" for a price (the charter also carries negated "not until" sentences in task 0).

[Base-invariant card] J subject alignment_readjustment: alignment_evt_readjustment.within_guarantee (anchor = corrected alignment 2026-08-08, +6 calendar months -> 2027-02-08 inclusive, not_after; 2026-10-14 inside; miles 2670 <= 6000; no recorded impact claim; out of specification as posted by the store). The guarantee applies though the plan is expired (base: any holding status). R subject alignment_purchase: one_active_per_vehicle (the F-150's only plan is expired), multi_holding scope, pricing scope (light_truck personal inside the 3-Year gate; expiration 2029-10-14), commercial-use scope.

[Business-object card] Open readjustment RJ (only readjustment row with basis none; source_alignment_event_id = 2026-08-08 work order with a 119.99 kit). Renewal anchor E (only alignment plan). Grace evidence: latest plan_included 2026-08-08 (inside the final 6 months of a term ending 2026-08-19); included count 6 (2023-08-19, 2024-02-24, 2024-08-31, 2025-03-08, 2025-12-20, 2026-08-08); the member-early-price alignment 2025-06-14 is not counted. Near-misses: retired 2023 tire set and expired 2023 road hazard certificate (excluded by status), expiration-date grace (56 days > 30) which a reader of the computation document alone would apply.

[Factor cards] see computations[].factor_trace (tier, evidence, baseline figure). J 16.16 (all-baseline 129.99); R 112.59 (all-baseline 239.99). Cross-difficulty evidence seeded: tire_sets (tires), hazard_certificates + hazard_events (hazard), card_accounts + card_transactions (card; late fee 2026-03-23). Multi-source factors: parts_warranty_path, cardholder_* (account AND late fee window), new_tire_readjust_credit. Method pairwise tables: grace_period_anchor T1 latest included alignment in the final 6 months (months test from it) / T2 only a member-early-price alignment there (months test from that one) / T3 neither (days test from expiration) — a plan expired 56 days earlier with the last alignment 2 months back carries no reinstatement charge under T1/T2 and the charge under T3; T1/T2 differ when the included and early alignments sit 5 and 8 months back. parts_warranty_path free / prorated / listed — with 129.99 listed and 2670 mi: 0.00 / 28.92 / 129.99.

[Persona design] A plain-spoken retired surveyor; volunteers only "renew my 3-Year plan on the F-150 today"; identity (phone, ZIP), vehicle, debit card and Wadsworth store on request; the morning's readjustment, the new tires and the card only as answers to questions; runs the renewal when handed over; ends when told the truck is on a new 3-Year plan.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> find_vehicles -> find_alignment_plans -> find_alignment_events(E) -> find_tire_sets(VT) -> find_hazard_certificates(VT) -> find_hazard_events(HT1) -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> unlock/call readjustment 16.16 -> unlock_user/call_user renewal 112.59 (odometer 95720, expiration 2029-10-14, cash_or_debit, Wadsworth store).

[Verification] Built by /tmp/alignment_plan_service_0062/build1.py (scratch, deleted at the end) with check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on the replayed world before each write; per-factor and all-baseline substitutions; skip of step 11 recomputes the renewal at 137.59. Gate outputs are recorded in worklog.md.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] Reading only the renewal and readjustment rules, the schemas and the finder returns: the renewal sentence plus the open readjustment force the readjustment booking first; the warranty text gives the prorated kit; the grace text anchors on the 2026-08-08 alignment; the same two numbers follow, with no second reading found.
user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Vanterpool, a retired surveyor in Lakewood, Colorado, who drives a 2018 Ford F-150 and likes things done properly and in order. You speak slowly and plainly and you do not mind answering questions. You call Crestline because your 3-Year alignment plan on the F-150 ran out in August, and you want to renew it today, on this call. You have no idea what a renewal costs and you will not guess a figure.

When the agent asks how to look you up, you give your phone number, 3035550562. To confirm who you are you give your billing ZIP code, 80226; you give your date of birth, 1971-11-30, only if the agent asks for one more detail. The vehicle is the 2018 Ford F-150. If the agent asks how you want to pay, you say you will pay with your debit card. If the agent asks which store to use, you say the Wadsworth Boulevard store in Lakewood.

If the agent asks whether the truck was in for service today, you say yes, it had started pulling to the right, and this morning the Wadsworth store measured it and set it back, telling you it was still covered by the guarantee on your August alignment and that they had put in a new cam bolt kit. If the agent asks about tires or road hazard protection, you say you bought a new set of Crestline tires at the end of September with the better road hazard plan. If the agent asks about a Crestline card, you say you have the Crestline Mastercard and you paid one statement late back in March.

If the agent tells you something has to be settled on Crestline's side before the renewal is priced, you are happy to wait while they do it. When the agent hands you the renewal to complete yourself, you carry it out with exactly the details the agent gives you and read back what the system shows. You accept the figures the agent states, since you have nothing to compare them with. Once the agent tells you the F-150 is on a new 3-Year plan, you thank them and end the call.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Months are counted as calendar months from the anchor date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist.
